{{Top}}
{{Quote|We could find ourselves marooned forever on this empty world, without companionship, without knowledge tapes, without ... without ''lubricants''!|[[C-3PO]]|<ref name="Splinter of the Mind's Eye">''[[Splinter of the Mind's Eye]]''</ref>}}
A '''lubricant''' was a substance used to lower the friction between two surfaces.

[[Moisture vaporator/Legends|Moisture vaporators]] required lubricant to operate. Sand getting into a vaporator's lubricant could disable the machine until it was removed.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
{{Substance-stub}}
